title: llocal.json
description: How llocal builds an app, starts it and what it needs. Commands run with /bin/sh -c in the app's root folder. The checker (llocal-check) applies the full rules.

shape.description: standard: a Go server on llocal's kit with SQLite. kept: the app's own server, kept, with its data on SQLite. static: only files, no server.

base.description: The stock image the app is built and run in. go also has Node, for building a front end. static has no toolchain.

install.description: Installs dependencies, like npm ci. Has network through llocal's package proxy.

build.description: Builds the app, like go build -o server . && cd web && npm run build.

start.description: Runs the server. It must listen on $PORT on all interfaces.

migrate.description: Brings the database up to date before each start. Leave out for kit apps, which migrate at start.

port.description: The port the server listens on. llocal sets $PORT to it.

static.description: The folder, inside the app, of built front-end files. Served with index.html for unknown paths.

persistent.description: Files or folders inside the app that must survive a restart. They are linked into /data.

build_settings.description: Names of public settings the front-end build bakes in. Changing one rebuilds.

secrets.description: Names of secrets the server reads from its environment. Set in llocal, never in the repo.

services.description: Outside services the app still uses, like stripe or openai.

cron.description: Five numeric cron fields in the app's time zone, like 0 6 * * *.

schedules.description: Paths llocal calls on a timetable.

machine_paths.description: Paths open to machines with an access key, like webhooks.
